name: reversibility-assessment
description: For each decision, assess its reversibility. Ask three questions: (1) If I choose wrong, can I undo it? (2) What would undoing it cost in money, time, and relationships? (3) How long do I have before the choice becomes irreversible? Classify as one-way door, two-way door, or sliding door (currently two-way but becoming one-way as a deadline approaches).
